mapper.select: SELECT i.ID AS id, i.DEPLOYMENT_ID AS deploymentId, i.BUSINESS_KEY AS businessKey, i.EXECUTION_STATUS AS executionStatus, i.CURRENT_NODE_ID AS currentNodeId, i.STATE_JSON AS stateJson, i.ENV_CODE AS envCode, i.DELETED AS deleted, i.CREATE_USER AS createUser, i.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, i.UPDATE_USER AS updateUser, i.UPDATE_TIME AS updateTime FROM AST_FLOW_INSTANCE i WHERE i.ID = #{id} AND (i.DELETED = 0 OR i.DELETED IS NULL)
